summary: Killing or stopping a Pod mid-install leaves the whole allocated partial behind - an aria2 .part at its FULL declared length, or the HuggingFace <dest>.part.hfstage tree - and nothing removes it: the wrapper's delete handles dest and dest+'.part' only, and the app's orphan sweep maps volume files to deps so an unmappable staging path is invisible to it. The app's free-space gate then counts that leftover against the retry of the very dep aria2 is about to overwrite, so Install is refused for space it would reclaim. Third symptom on the same route: a gate-blocked remote install leaves its job at status 'queued' indefinitely with no error state. All three measured live on 2026-08-10 during MPI-483/MPI-481's Pod session.
